Extend the ROUTINES engine so automation can chase, escalate, watch silence and react to replies, with trust levels and undo. Work in the repo directly; do NOT commit or push. Others work in parallel: you may edit src/ask_soony/routines.py, src/ask_soony/replies.py, src/ask_soony/cardtools.py (only to add a reusable "send follow-up in the same thread" helper), and create tests/test_routines_more.py. Do NOT edit api.py, background.py, papercheck.py, scripts/, web/. A frontend engineer builds the UI against the API contract below in parallel, so implement the contract exactly (extend it only additively and list additions in your report).

Repo /Users/jonasstenglein/OtherProjects/StartMunichHack/ask-soony. Read first: src/ask_soony/routines.py (recipe spec, clean_spec, compile_spec and its COMPILED template, _Run building blocks, run(), suggest/edit/preview, routes), src/ask_soony/replies.py (reply poller, decision_status reply fields), src/ask_soony/cardtools.py (deliver(), _send_mail, supplier_addresses), src/ask_soony/api.py (read-only: build_state, approve/escalate/dismiss, _record, read_list/read_json/write_json, now(), state["clock"]["launch"], state["shipments"] with silent/silent_hours/supplier_id), src/ask_soony/alerts.py + escalation.py + openai_calls.py (raising an alert that phones a person: AlertBook.raise_alert(...) and the Escalator/make_caller path; provider from env ASK_CALL_PROVIDER, which is "dry_run" in .env so nothing is dialled unless configured), tests/test_routines.py and tests/conftest.py (fixtures agent_env, in_my_inbox pattern). Tests run in an empty cwd (autouse fixture); `uv run pytest -q` must pass; `uv run ruff check src tests --exclude tests/test_platform.py` clean (100 cols; multi-line docstrings start with """ alone; no em dashes). Never send real email or place real calls in tests (monkeypatch _send_mail and the caller).

API/recipe CONTRACT (the UI relies on it):
1. Recipe additions (clean_spec + compiler + SPEC_HELP for the writer/editor agent):
   - optional top-level `"on"`: "decisions" (default: open inbox cards), "waiting" (decisions already sent to a supplier with no reply yet), "shipments" (shipments that stopped updating).
   - condition fields added: `hours_left` (hours until the card's decide-by; ops "lt"/"gt" with a number value), `waiting_hours` (hours since the message was sent; lt/gt), `has_reply` (op "is", value "yes"/"no"), `reply_after_launch` (is yes/no), `silent_hours` (shipments; lt/gt), plus existing text fields. Numeric ops "lt"/"gt" added to OPS.
   - step kinds added: `chase` (send ONE polite follow-up in the same email thread to the same supplier, using a template message with {headline}/{supplier}; free communication; at most once per card per routine unless `"repeat_hours"` is set), `call` (phone the responsible person through the existing alert/escalation path with a short text; the money/plan guard does not apply, it is a call to our own buyer; respects ASK_CALL_PROVIDER), `ask_status` (on shipments: email the supplier contact from its profile asking for a status of that shipment; free).
   - every step keeps `id` and buyer-readable `text`.
2. Building blocks in the sandbox module `soony` (stubs + _Run): `waiting_cards() -> list[dict]` (sent decisions without reply: id, headline, supplier_name, hours_since_sent, to, subject), `silent_shipments() -> list[dict]` (id, supplier_id, supplier_name, silent_hours, eta), `chase(card_id, message) -> dict`, `call(text, card_id) -> dict`, `ask_status(shipment_id, message) -> dict`; open_cards() items gain `hours_left`, `has_reply`, `reply_after_launch`. Dry runs only record.
3. Trust levels: each routine has `mode`: "ask" | "tell" | "quiet" (default "tell" for new routines; keep `enabled` as the on/off switch, mode is independent). In "ask" mode, side-effect steps (carry_out, chase, ask_status, call) are NOT executed: they become PROPOSALS stored in state file routine_proposals.json: {id, routine_id, routine_name, card_id?, shipment_id?, step: {do, text, ...}, preview_text (what would be sent/said), created_at, status: "pending"|"done"|"skipped"}. "tell": execute + notify the buyer (phone push) one line per action. "quiet": execute + log only.
   Routes: GET /api/routines/proposals → {proposals: [...pending first]}; POST /api/routines/proposals/{id}/accept → executes that one step now (same code path as a real run), returns {ok, result}; POST /api/routines/proposals/{id}/skip. POST /api/routines/{id}/mode {mode}.
4. Undo: every real routine action is recorded in actions.json with `via: "routine: <name>"` (approve path already does) and an `id`. POST /api/routines/actions/{action_id}/undo: for an approval/notes without an email → put the card back to open (remove its decision_status entry, append an "undo" action) and return {ok: true, undone: true}; for a sent email/chase/ask_status → {ok: false, reason: "The email already went out. Send a correction instead?"} (do not unsend); calls → {ok:false, reason:"The call already happened."}.
5. "Would handle": GET /api/routines/would-handle → {card_id: [{routine_id, routine_name, mode, enabled}]} computed by dry-running routines that are OFF or in "ask" mode against the open inbox (cache for ~30 s; cheap).
6. Replies: in replies.py, when a supplier reply is attached, also extract facts with the existing summariser call (one call, JSON): {new_date (ISO or null), quantity (number or null), after_launch (bool, compare with state clock launch), confirms (bool)}; store on the decision_status entry as reply_date, reply_quantity, reply_after_launch; if after_launch, push "Supplier confirms after launch: <headline>". Keep the existing behaviour and tests.
7. Time triggers run with the existing background loop (run_enabled every ASK_ROUTINES_SECONDS); make `first_time` keys for chase include the repeat window so repeat_hours works.
8. Writer/editor prompts: teach the LLM the new fields/steps/`on` with 2 short examples in plain buyer language: "If a supplier has not answered within 2 hours, chase once; if still nothing after 4 hours, call me" and "If a red decision is still open 2 hours before its deadline, call the person responsible" and "When a shipment has not updated for 12 hours, ask the supplier for its status".
Tests: compile + dry run for each new step/field/trigger; ask-mode creates proposals and accept executes exactly once; undo restores a card / refuses for email; would-handle; reply facts stored (summariser monkeypatched). Final report: contract as implemented (with any additions), test results.

     2	Routines: after a person decided something by hand, an agent offers to do it automatically next
     3	time. It writes a small Python routine from a fixed set of building blocks, which runs in the
     4	Monty sandbox (pydantic-monty) on every check: no network, no files, no imports except the
     5	`soony` module below, type-checked against its stubs before it is saved.
     6	
     7	The trust ladder stays: a routine can carry out an option only if it just communicates (an email
     8	or a message to a person) and costs nothing. Re-plans, allocations, orders and anything with a
     9	price still go to a person; the routine can only notify about them. Every run
    10	is recorded with what it printed and what it did, and every action it takes lands in the inbox
    11	history like a click, marked with the routine's name.
    12	
    13	Building blocks (module `soony`):
    14	  open_cards() -> list[dict]         open decisions: id, headline, level, kind, part, supplier,
    15	                                     number, deadline, evidence[{source, value}], options[...]
    16	  carry_out(card_id, option_index, reason) -> dict   approve an option (sends its email if any)
    17	  notify(text, card_id) -> None      push and Teams
    18	  log(text) -> None                  a line in the run record
    19	  first_time(key) -> bool            True once per key per routine (avoid repeating yourself)
    20	  now() -> str                       current time, ISO 8601

    24	import logging

   301	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- recipe (spec) and compiler

   307	FIELDS = {"evidence", "headline", "option_action", "option_to", "supplier_name", "kind"}

   313	def clean_spec(spec: dict) -> dict:
   314	    """Validate and normalise a recipe; raises ValueError with a buyer-readable reason."""
   315	    if not isinstance(spec, dict):
   316	        raise ValueError("the recipe is not an object")
   317	    when, then = [], []
   318	    for i, c in enumerate(spec.get("when") or []):
   319	        field, op = str(c.get("field") or ""), str(c.get("op") or "contains")
   320	        value = str(c.get("value") or "").strip()
   321	        if field not in FIELDS or op not in OPS or not value:
   322	            raise ValueError(f"condition {i + 1} is not understood")
   323	        when.append(
   324	            {
   325	                "id": str(c.get("id") or f"c{i + 1}"),
   326	                "field": field,
   327	                "op": op,
   328	                "value": value[:120],
   329	                "text": str(c.get("text") or value)[:160],
   330	            }
   331	        )
   332	    for i, st in enumerate(spec.get("then") or []):
   333	        do = str(st.get("do") or "")
   334	        if do not in STEPS:
   335	            raise ValueError(f"step {i + 1} is not understood")
   336	        step = {
   337	            "id": str(st.get("id") or f"s{i + 1}"),
   338	            "do": do,
   339	            "text": str(st.get("text") or do)[:160],
   340	        }

   342	            m = st.get("match") or {}
   343	            step["match"] = {k: str(m[k])[:80] for k in ("to", "action_contains") if m.get(k)}
   344	        if do == "notify":
   345	            ch = str(st.get("channel") or "both")
   346	            step["channel"] = ch if ch in CHANNELS else "both"
   347	            step["message"] = str(st.get("message") or "{headline}")[:200]
   348	        if do == "log":
   349	            step["message"] = str(st.get("message") or st.get("text") or "")[:200]
   350	        then.append(step)

   352	        raise ValueError("a routine needs at least one condition")
   353	    if not then:
   354	        raise ValueError("a routine needs at least one step")
   355	    return {"when": when, "then": then}

Twilio, OpenAI realtime and ElevenLabs call these from outside, so they are exempt from the
dashboard login and authenticate themselves instead: OpenAI with a signed webhook, Twilio and
ElevenLabs with the per-alert secret token embedded in the URL or body.

import hmac

def _xml(body: str) -> Response:
    return Response(body, media_type="text/xml")


def _book() -> tuple[Store, AlertBook]:
    store = Store(Settings.from_env().data_dir)
    return store, AlertBook(store)


def _alert_for(book: AlertBook, alert_id: int, token: str):
    a = book.get(alert_id)
    return a if a and hmac.compare_digest(token, a.token) else None


@router.post("/hooks/openai")
async def openai_incoming(request: Request):
    from ask_soony.openai_calls import start_incoming, verify_webhook

    raw = await request.body()
    if not verify_webhook(request.headers, raw, os.environ.get("OPENAI_WEBHOOK_SECRET", "")):
        return PlainTextResponse("bad signature", 401)
    event = json.loads(raw or b"{}")
    if event.get("type") == "realtime.call.incoming":
        start_incoming(event, Settings.from_env().data_dir)
    return PlainTextResponse("ok")


@router.post("/hooks/openai/twiml/{alert_id}")
def openai_twiml(alert_id: int, token: str = ""):
    from ask_soony.openai_calls import OpenAICaller

    store, book = _book()
    try:
        a = _alert_for(book, alert_id, token)
        if not a:
            return PlainTextResponse("forbidden", 403)
        return _xml(OpenAICaller.from_env().twiml(a))
    finally:
        store.db.close()


@router.post("/hooks/twilio/twiml/{alert_id}")
def twilio_twiml(alert_id: int, token: str = ""):
    store, book = _book()

        if not a:

        public = os.environ.get("ASK_PUBLIC_URL", "").rstrip("/")
        return _xml(TwilioCaller("", "", "").twiml(a, public))
    finally:
        store.db.close()

    from urllib.parse import parse_qs

                    decision,
                    by="phone …" + form.get("To", [""])[0][-2:],
                    channel="call",
                    token=token,
                )
            except (KeyError, PermissionError):
                return PlainTextResponse("forbidden", 403)
            say = f"Thank you. Your decision, {decision}, is recorded."
        return _xml(f"<Response><Say>{escape(say)}</Say></Response>")
    finally:
        store.db.close()

def _escalation_loop(settings: Settings, every: int = 30) -> None:
    """Background loop: escalate undecided alerts once their answer time has run out."""
    import time

    from ask_soony.alerts import AlertBook, Policy
    from ask_soony.escalation import Escalator, Mailer, make_caller

    while True:
        try:
            store = Store(settings.data_dir)
            escalator = Escalator(
                AlertBook(store),
                Policy.load(settings.alert_policy),
                make_caller(settings.call_provider),
                Mailer.from_env(),
                settings.public_url,
            )
            escalator.tick()

            print(f"escalation loop: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        time.sleep(every)

    no = agent_env["client"].post(
        tool, json={"name": "decide", "arguments": {"decision": "approve"}}
    )
    assert no.json()["ok"] is False and agent_env["sent"] == []
    yes = agent_env["client"].post(
        tool, json={"name": "decide", "arguments": {"decision": "approve", "confirmed": True}}
    )
    out = yes.json()
    assert (out["ok"], out["status"], out["sent_to"]) == (True, "sent", SUPPLIER)
    assert len(agent_env["sent"]) == 1
    again = agent_env["client"].post(
        tool, json={"name": "decide", "arguments": {"decision": "approve", "confirmed": True}}
    )
    assert again.json()["ok"] is False and len(agent_env["sent"]) == 1


def test_reply_is_attached_to_the_card(agent_env, monkeypatch):
    from ask_soony import replies

    agent_env["client"].post("/api/cards/gap-X/approve", json={"option": 0})
    reply = EmailMessage()
    reply["From"], reply["Subject"] = f"Ann <{SUPPLIER}>", "Re: 300 copies short"
    reply["Message-ID"], reply["In-Reply-To"] = "<[REDACTED_EMAIL]>", "<m1@x>"
    reply.set_content("Yes, 300 on Sunday's 06:00 truck.\n\n> Earlier truck?")

    class FakeImap:
        def __init__(self, *a, **k): ...
        def login(self, *a): ...
        def select(self, *a, **k): ...
        def search(self, *a):
            return "OK", [b"1"]

        def fetch(self, *a):
            return "OK", [(b"1", reply.as_bytes())]

        def logout(self): ...

    monkeypatch.setattr(replies.imaplib, "IMAP4_SSL", FakeImap)
    monkeypatch.setattr(replies, "load_dotenv", lambda: None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(replies, "summarise", lambda text, subject: "300 on Sunday 06:00")
    for k in ("ASK_IMAP_HOST", "ASK_MAIL_ADDRESS", "ASK_MAIL_PASSWORD"):
        monkeypatch.setenv(k, "x")

    assert [r["card_id"] for r in replies.check_once()] == ["gap-X"]
    assert replies.check_once() == []  # seen once only
    st = _status(agent_env)
    assert st["status"] == "sent" and st["reply"] == "300 on Sunday 06:00"
    assert st["reply_text"] == "Yes, 300 on Sunday's 06:00 truck."
    card = next(
        c for c in agent_env["client"].get("/api/state").json()["cards"] if c["id"] == "gap-X"
    )
    assert card["ui"]["reply_from"] == "Ann"
    kinds = [a["kind"] for a in json.loads((agent_env["state"] / "actions.json").read_text())]
    assert kinds == ["approve", "reply"]
